channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] State health dept. issues health advisory, recommends against swimming at Bahia Beach in Ruskin
item.description: The state health department has recommended against swimming and other water-related activities at Bahia Beach due to water quality issues.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] After six months of war in Iran, is the US achieving its goals?
item.description: Six months after the Iran war began, there still is no off-ramp in sight despite Trump's repeated assertions that the war has been won or a deal to resolve it was nearly complete.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump brings GOP support to Texas, but MAGA Inc. super PAC spending is still quiet
item.description: Trump-supporting Maga Inc. has more than $400 million available, according to filings. But it has yet to tap into most of its funds for the midterm election cycle.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] News Tonight - Top Headlines and Weather for August 27
item.description: Here are the top headlines from the day, from here in Tampa Bay and around the world. Tampa Bay 28 Chief Meteorologist Denis Phillips gives Florida's most accurate forecast.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Controllers warned Trump copter pilots about radio failures 1 week before they came close to jet
item.description: Air traffic controllers in Washington and the pilots of President Trump’s helicopter discussed communication issues one week before a close call with a commercial jet, investigators said Thursday.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bipartisan push for investigation into Flock Safety cameras grows amid misuse allegations
item.description: Lawmakers on both sides of the aisle are calling for investigations into Flock Safety cameras. Are these license plate readers a public safety tool or a surveillance threat?

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pasco mosquito officials urge precautions as dengue cases rise in Tampa Bay
item.description: Mosquito control officials are urging Tampa Bay residents to take precautions as locally acquired dengue cases rise across the region, including 30 confirmed cases in Hillsborough County.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Jolly calls for Hope Florida investigation to be reopened after leak of grand jury report
item.description: Democratic candidate for Florida governor David Jolly is calling for the Hope Florida investigation to be reopened.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump looks to boost Texas Republicans as Senate race shifts toward Democrats
item.description: President Donald Trump is hoping to give Republicans a boost in Texas as he attends a GOP fundraiser in Houston amid signs the state's high-profile Senate race is on the verge of going to Democrats.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Communication failures preceded safety incident involving Marine One, NTSB says
item.description: Air traffic controllers did not hear Marine One’s warnings before a passenger jet took off as President Trump’s helicopter left the White House on Aug. 4, officials said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] New College of Florida is spending nearly $1 million on outside PR consultants
item.description: Public records reveal New College of Florida awarded no-bid contracts to two outside PR consultants with political ties to Governor DeSantis and college President Richard Corcoran, even as the school employs a 13-member communications team.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Mulberry academy launches uniform drive to help rural, low-income families
item.description: RCMA Mulberry Community Academy is holding its first uniform drive after seeing some students come to school without the required clothing.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] ICE plans to buy vehicle stopping device after fatal pursuits
item.description: ICE is planning to buy a device that stops fleeing cars — weeks after agents shot and killed 2 drivers who didn't stop for unmarked vehicles.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Callaway breaks with golf media company Good Good after blowback to controversial ad
item.description: Golf equipment maker Callaway is severing ties with Good Good after the golf company’s controversial advertisement that featured one of its co-founders pushing over a female member of their team.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Overpay on rent? This settlement could mean money back in your pocket
item.description: Millions of U.S. renters may qualify for a payout from a nearly $360 million RealPage rent-fixing settlement. Here's what you need to know to file a claim. 💰

item.title: [WATCHLIST: city council] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Rays stadium deal: Tampa City Council approves funding for $2.3B ballpark project
item.description: Tampa City Council has approved their portion of the funding for the Tampa Bay Rays' proposed stadium deal in a key vote on Thursday.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Teens charged as adults in brutal beating of homeless man
item.description: Three teens accused of beating and critically injuring a homeless man in Tampa are now being charged as adults.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Hillsborough County Juvenile Detention Center to close, teenagers moved out of facility
item.description: All the teenagers being held at the Hillsborough County Juvenile Detention Center are expected to be moved out of the facility by the end of Thursday, according to Hillsborough County Public Defender Lisa McLean.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Billy Adams case: 'Main' girlfriend testifies as rapper's murder trial continues
item.description: Prosecutors say Tampa rapper, Billy Adams shot his pregnant girlfriend back in 2023 in order to continue his relationship with another woman.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Businessman Bill Edwards dies, leaving lasting St. Petersburg legacy
item.description: St. Petersburg is mourning the loss of businessman and philanthropist Bill Edwards, who died Thursday at the age of 81, according to local officials and community leaders.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: city council] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] St. Petersburg utility rates: City Council approves rate increase
item.description: The St. Petersburg City Council voted to raise utility rates, including water, wastewater, storm water and sanitation.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Clearwater moves to establish manatee protection zone in Stevenson Creek
item.description: Clearwater officials are moving forward with plans to create a new manatee protection zone aimed at safeguarding the marine mammals in Stevenson Creek.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Man dies after steel beam falls on him in Clearwater
item.description: A man is dead after a steel beam fell on him Thursday morning in Clearwater, according to the Pinellas County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Sea Oats see impressive results off Anna Maria Island, project will continue
item.description: A community effort on Anna Maria Island is turning a stretch of Bradenton Beach into a thriving defense against future storms.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] The Nest at Robins Apartments pairs affordable housing with affordable medical care
item.description: A unique partnership between One Stop Housing and MCR Health is giving Manatee County workforce families an affordable place to live alongside accessible healthcare.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Polk County fire chaplain laid to rest after deadly Eagle Lake dump truck crash
item.description: A Polk County Fire Rescue volunteer chaplain was laid to rest Wednesday — one week after he was killed in an Eagle Lake crash involving a dump truck.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Inside Amazon Air’s high-speed Lakeland operation
item.description: Ever wondered how your Amazon package makes it to your doorstep in less than 24 hours?

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Pasco murder-suicide: Man, woman found dead inside Lutz home
item.description: Two are dead after a murder-suicide in the Cot Road area of Lutz, according to Pasco County deputies.
